title: Saudi Embassy Requirements Guidance
description: Understand the recipient’s request and the official consular instructions before arranging a submission.
answer: We provide independent preparation guidance for Saudi-bound documents. Only the competent mission or authority can decide the applicable process and issue an official attestation.

sections.title: Clarify the document’s purpose
sections.text: Employment, study, family and commercial uses can require different evidence. Ask the recipient for a written list and identify whether it wants an original, copy or translation.

sections.title: Prepare the right questions
sections.text: Confirm the document category, prerequisites, appearance requirements and permitted submission channel directly with the relevant mission or authority.

sections.title: No assumed agent access
sections.text: We do not claim to be an embassy representative or authorised submission agent. Applicant-only or otherwise restricted steps must be completed through the official channel.

sections.title: Before any paid assistance
sections.text: Agree the exact preparation work separately. Official charges and service fees should be distinguished; no fixed government fee, delivery date or approval is promised here.
